data.one_liner: A Dart port of Puppeteer to automate and control Chrome over the DevTools Protocol.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to automate browser tasks like generating screenshots and PDFs, crawling SPAs, automating form submissions, and running UI tests directly in Chrome. It also includes a fully typed API of the Chrome DevTools protocol generated from JSON Schema.
use_when: You need to automate browser interactions or scrape single-page applications.
You want to generate screenshots or PDFs of web pages programmatically.
You need to run automated browser and extension tests.
avoid_when: You are running on web/WASM where browser launching (`puppeteer.launch()`) is unsupported.
You only need to make simple HTTP requests without running a browser engine.
strengths: High-level API very similar to the original Node.js Puppeteer library.
Full access to the low-level Chrome DevTools protocol.
Supports browser extensions and advanced features like locators and screencasts.
weaknesses: Launching a local browser instance is not supported on web/WASM platforms.
Requires managing browser binaries and processes.
data.setup_notes: Can automatically download and launch Chrome binaries on native platforms.
